text.feels_intro: How {name}'s wrenched and pulled injuries feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s head: {his} hair is tangled and dragged out of place, the scalp beneath flushed pink, and one ear glows red and slightly puffy from being twisted.
{name}'s head: loose strands of torn-out hair cling to {his} shoulders; the scalp is blotched red with tiny beads of blood at the roots, and one ear is swollen, hot and bruised purple along its fold.

{name}'s head: ragged bald patches show where hair was ripped out by the roots, the bare scalp raw, torn and oozing blood into what hair remains; one ear is split where it joins the head, swollen and dark with blood. Tears stream from {his} reddened eyes.
body: {name}'s back: a patch of skin is pinched red where it was grabbed and twisted.
{name}'s back: twisted skin has bruised purple in finger-shaped blotches.
{name}'s back: the skin is torn where it was wrenched, bleeding inside dark, twisted bruises.
arm: {name}'s {part}: red finger marks ring the wrist where it was gripped and wrenched, and the arm hangs a little stiffly.
{name}'s {part}: dark grip bruises circle the wrist and upper arm, the elbow is puffy, and the shoulder sits slightly hunched and swollen from being forced behind {his} back.

{name}'s {part}: the shoulder sits wrong, sagging and lumpy as if pulled from its socket; the skin at the wrist is torn and bleeding where it was twisted, the whole arm swollen and bruised black from shoulder to fingers, held limp at {his} side.
leg: {name}'s {part}: the ankle is reddened with finger marks where it was gripped and twisted.
{name}'s {part}: the knee is puffy and bruised purple along the inside, and the ankle is swollen from being wrenched.
{name}'s {part}: the knee is badly swollen and bent at a strange angle, the ankle fat and bruised black, the skin torn where it was twisted and bleeding into {his} boot.

head: {name}'s scalp prickles hot and tight where {his} hair was yanked, and {his} ear burns and rings. {name} is startled and indignant, eyes watering, holding {his} head stiff and still.

{name}'s scalp throbs and stings at the roots, sore to the touch of {his} own hair, and {his} twisted ear aches with a deep, hot pulse. {name} is angry and humiliated, flinching when {his} hair shifts and tilting {his} head away from the hurt side.

{name}'s scalp is a raw, burning agony where the hair was torn out, every strand left screaming at the slightest movement; {his} ear pounds with a tearing pain and a roar of ringing. {name} is shaking, tearful and terrified, hunched with {his} head pulled down between {his} shoulders, barely able to turn it.
body: {name}'s back stings sharply where the skin was pinched and twisted. {name} holds {his} shoulders tight.
{name}'s back aches in hot, bruised spots where it was wrenched. {name} keeps {his} back stiff and straight.
{name}'s back burns with a raw, tearing pain where the skin was torn. {name} moves slowly, wincing at every twist.
arm: {name}'s {part} aches with a sharp twinge at the wrist and shoulder, and the joints feel strained. {name} is shaken and rubs the wrist, reluctant to raise the arm.
{name}'s {part} throbs deep in the shoulder and elbow, and lifting it sends a hot, grinding pain through the joint. {name} is resentful and guarded, keeping the arm close and gripping weakly.

{name}'s {part} is a sickening, tearing agony in the shoulder, as if it hangs loose from its socket; every jolt sends white-hot pain down to the fingers, which tingle and go numb. {name} is in shock, pale and sweating, clutching the arm against {his} body and unable to lift it at all.
leg: {name}'s {part} twinges at the ankle where it was twisted. {name} is shaken, with a slight hitch in {his} step.
{name}'s {part} aches deep in the knee and ankle, and full weight brings a sharp, wrenching pain. {name} limps stiffly, keeping the knee straight.
{name}'s {part} is a grinding, tearing agony in the knee, which feels loose and wrong, and the ankle cannot bear weight. {name} is panicked and exhausted, unable to stand on the leg without support.

head: {name}'s scalp and ear feel normal again. A hand in {his} hair brings back a quiet memory of being dragged by it.
{name}'s scalp tingles where the new hair grows in, and {his} ear is a little sore when pressed. {name} flinches when anyone reaches toward {his} hair.

{name}'s scalp is tender and itchy under the scabs, and lying on that side of {his} head hurts. {name} is self-conscious about the bare patches, touching {his} hair often and turning {his} head carefully.
body: {name}'s back is only a little sore when pressed. {name} is wary of hands behind {him}.
{name}'s back is tender and itchy under the scabs. {name} avoids leaning back against anything.
arm: {name}'s {part} has its full movement and strength again. Having the arm grabbed brings back a quiet memory of it being wrenched.
{name}'s {part} is a little tight at full reach and twinges when {he} lifts anything heavy. {name} uses it almost normally but keeps it from being pulled behind {him}.
{name}'s {part} is stiff and sore, the shoulder catching with a deep ache when {he} reaches or lifts. {name} is frustrated at the weakness and favors the other arm.
leg: {name}'s {part} has its full strength and movement again, a quiet memory of the twisting.
{name}'s {part} is slightly stiff in the morning or the cold. {name} walks almost normally but is careful on rough ground.
{name}'s {part} is stiff and sore at knee and ankle, aching after a little walking. {name} limps and rests the leg when {he} can.

levels: , a sudden, wrenching yank that tears a startled cry from {name}. Hot, prickling pain floods the spot and {name}'s eyes sting with tears as {name}'s body jerks to follow the pull.
where it is already sore. The tender ache flares into a sharp, tearing burn as strained skin and joints are wrenched again, and {name} gasps, straining against the grip.

, twisting bruised and strained flesh past its limit. The deep throb becomes a sickening, grinding jolt that drops into {name}'s gut, and {name} cries out, {name}'s composure breaking as {name} is dragged off balance.

, and it is too much. Something tears with a white-hot rip that throws {name} into shock: the blood drains from {name}'s face, cold sweat breaks out, {name}'s vision swims, and {name} sags helplessly in the grip.

level.high: The last soreness in {name}'s {parts} is fading; the hair is growing back and the joints move almost freely.
level.mid: The scabs on {name}'s {parts} have fallen away and new hair and strength are returning.
level.low: The tears on {name}'s {parts} have scabbed over and the swelling is easing.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to ease {own} strained joints, torn scalp and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to ease {own} strained joints, torn scalp and pain.

start_unhurt.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. With no wounds to mend, it simply washes over {obj}, warm and soothing.
start_unhurt.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. With no wounds to mend, it simply feels warm and soothing.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s wrenched joints and torn scalp is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} wrenched joints and torn scalp, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s pulled and wrenched injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s pulled and wrenched injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s pulled and wrenched injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.
